messages.content: Please check AAPL, get the USD-to-EUR exchange rate, and turn that rate into a short note. Then assess the risk of a $1500 trade, and if it passes, place a $1500 buy order for AAPL. After that, check the current NASDAQ market window and send that market status to user_123 in the app with high priority. Also check the status of light_living in the living room and set its brightness to 75. Finally, save a document titled "Trade and Market Context Note" using the exchange-rate note, and tag it with finance, trade, and iot.
